title: Would You Rather Generator - Random Questions
meta_description: Pick a light, general-audience Would You Rather question for conversations, classes, or group games.
intro: Choose from 120 general, funny, kids, or thoughtful Would You Rather questions.

sections.h2: How do I get a Would You Rather question?
sections.content: Click Generate for one built-in question. Ask both sides to explain their choice if the group wants a longer discussion.
The prompts are written for a broad audience and avoid adult-only categories. Still, read each prompt before using it with children, students, or a work group.
Yes. A pass or re-roll rule keeps a voluntary social game comfortable for everyone.

faq.question: Can I choose a category?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose General, Funny, Kids, Thoughtful, or All categories.

faq.question: Can I add my own questions?
faq.answer: No. Custom question lists are not supported.

faq.question: Will questions repeat?
faq.answer: They can. Each click is an independent random pick.
